en.title: Why passport photos get rejected
en.focal: Your passport office publishes the exact size
en.alt: Hand-drawn sketchnote of six rejected passport photos - shadow behind the head, smiling, glasses glare, hair across the eyes, patterned background and photo taken too close - beside one accepted photo on a plain background with a neutral face and even light
en.caption: Six ways a photo gets sent back, and the one setup that passes.
